title: 0xGF/boneyard
why_good: Auto-generates skeleton loaders from your UI — a genuine time-saver, but a narrow front-end utility.
value: Hard to charge for directly; value is as a dev-tool/plugin, maybe a paid pro tier inside a bigger UI toolkit.
risk: Component libraries and frameworks add skeletons natively; small scope with easy substitutes.
pick_reason: The project offers a specific product that automates a common development task, making it viable for monetization.

zh.claim: 0xGF/boneyard —— 自动生成骨架屏(skeleton loading)框架。
zh.why_good: 从你的 UI 自动生成骨架屏——确实省时,但是个窄的前端小工具。
zh.value: 很难直接收费;价值在于做开发工具/插件,或塞进更大 UI 套件里的付费专业版。
zh.risk: 组件库和框架都在原生加骨架屏;范围小、替代品好找。
zh.hook: 从你的 UI 自动生成骨架屏——确实省时,虽然范围窄。

hook: Auto-generates skeleton loaders straight from your UI — a real time-saver, if a narrow one.
